ground_truth_scope: Only davis-001-bike-packing object 1 has per-frame ground truth; traffic-002 and traffic-003 do not.
conclusion: All three product categories now have real licensed-video regression evidence, and the official DAVIS J/F pipeline is reproducible. The quantified DAVIS sequence is not a road-traffic scene and does not complete CP-07.
limitations: Pedestrian and road non-motorized clips have no per-frame ground truth.
The quantified DAVIS bike-packing sequence begins indoors and is metric-pipeline evidence rather than traffic-scene evidence.
The DAVIS data is used locally for non-commercial research and is not redistributed.
